finalProject.prompt: Explain how Teddy Riley invented and shaped New Jack Swing through drum programming, synth-based arrangements, and R&B/hip-hop fusion. Compare ONE Guy-era track (‘Groove Me’) with ONE Blackstreet-era track (‘No Diggity’) and identify TWO modern producers or artists clearly influenced by Teddy Riley’s sound.
